blogs.title: Why Direction Matters: The Power of Neuron Angles in Text‑to‑Image Diffusion
blogs.description: Dive into the core intuition behind Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT). Discover why researchers focus on rotating neurons rather than changing their magnitudes, how angular information captures semantic meaning, and how an orthogonal transformation can tweak a diffusion model’s behavior without losing its original knowledge.

blogs.title: Orthogonal Finetuning 101: From Theory to Practical Implementation
blogs.description: Step through the mechanics of OFT – what hyperspherical energy is, why preserving it matters, and how learning a shared orthogonal matrix per layer keeps a model stable. We explain the Cayley parametrization, block‑diagonal tricks for efficiency, and how COFT adds a radius constraint for extra safety.

blogs.title: Putting a Model on a Checkered Path: Subject‑Driven Generation Made Easy
blogs.description: Explore how OFT is applied to DreamBooth‑style tasks where a few photos of a person must be remembered. Compare convergence, stability, and visual fidelity against classic fine‑tuning and LoRA. Learn why OFT can keep identity intact while still following creative prompts.

blogs.title: "Control” with Confidence: From Canny Edges to Real‑World Images via COFT
blogs.description: See how Constrained OFT lets you steer diffusion models with line sketches, segmentation maps, or facial landmarks. We walk through the new control consistency metric, show data‑efficiency gains, and explain why COFT delivers smoother training curves than ControlNet or T2I‑Adapter.

blogs.title: Beyond Image Generation: Composability and Future Directions for Orthogonal Finetuning
blogs.description: Look ahead to the open problems in OFT research. We discuss scalability challenges with matrix inverses, the promise of composing multiple orthogonal transforms for multi‑task learning, and the balance between parameter efficiency and model flexibility.
